events.verdict: After initially making contact with the ball, Bagley III (SAC) makes contact to Westbrook's (OKC) arm that affects his ability to pass.
Adams (OKC) is already in Shumpert's (SAC) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
George (OKC) brings his arm up and makes inadvertent contact to Shumpert's (SAC) head, affecting his ability to defend the inbound.
LAR shows George (OKC) turns into Fox's (SAC) path and delivers contact as he sets the pick.
Available camera angles show Cauley-Stein (SAC) does not make contact with George (OKC) as he goes over the screen.
RAR shows Adams (OKC) extends his arms into Bagley III (SAC) but does not affect his SQBR.
RO SLA shows that Adams (OKC) makes contact to Cauley-Stein's (SAC) arm and affects his shot near the rim.
[Observable in enhanced video] LAR shows Schroder (OKC) slides his pivot foot on the perimeter.
Adams (OKC) holds Cauley-Stein's (SAC) jersey and affects his ability to get to the rebound.
Schroder (OKC) cleanly deflects the ball away from Fox (SAC).
Kings do not not exit the timeout before the expiration of the timeout clock.
Schroder (OKC) does not make contact with Bagley III (SAC) during his shot near the rim.
Schroder (OKC) legally contests Bagley III's (SAC) shot near the rim.
Adams (OKC) does not establish a legal screening position in Fox's (SAC) path and contact occurs to his side.
Adams (OKC) legally contests Fox's (SAC) driving shot attempt.
Fox (SAC) legally contests George's (OKC) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Westbrook (OKC) commits a take foul on Bagley III (SAC).
Bagley III (SAC) takes longer than 10 seconds to shoot his free throw.
PXP shows Westbrook (OKC) enters the lane and does not pull his foot back before the shot is released.
Bagley III (SAC) and George (OKC) make incidental contact with one another as they attempt to secure the rebound.
Westbrook (OKC) engages with Fox (SAC) but does not affect his ability to defend the inbound.
Diallo (OKC) commits a take foul on Hield (SAC).
All Technical Fouls are reviewed by League Operations.
LLS shows Fox (SAC) does not move into George's (OKC) body and he maintains a legal guarding position as he defends the jump shot.
George (OKC) commits a take foul on Fox (SAC).
[Observable in enhanced video] Westbrook (OKC) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Hield (SAC) cleanly deflects the ball away from Westbrook (OKC).
